Three sequences per arm on one small synthetic API, not universal development efficiency.
Arms ran concurrently, so timings are not isolated performance benchmarks and cache effects may differ.
All arms retain artefacts across four fresh agent sessions. Natural tooling is unrestricted.
Prototype arms receive an explicit instruction to retain their selected interface; this measures usability under adoption, not spontaneous tool preference.
Installed Loop and helper are assumed; per-project setup is counted, but implementation and installation of the reusable kit are not.
